name: Wavelet-based Temporal Feature Extraction and Enhancement
definition: A compression-domain rendering technique for time-resolved volume data that uses wavelet multiresolution analysis to detect temporal singularities, retain time-varying structures, and suppress static regions to reduce memory usage and enhance feature visualization.
summary: This compression-domain technique uses wavelet multiresolution analysis and Lipschitz regularity to detect temporal singularities, suppressing static regions to reduce memory usage while enhancing time-varying structures.
